statements.t: (Jule) Smith, III, the Company’s President and Chief Executive Officer, said, “Today, we are announcing our preliminary fiscal 2026 financial results and introducing our fiscal 2027 outlook, reflecting our expectations for continued growth at CPI.

Despite these near-term challenges, our growth strategy remains firmly intact, and we are pleased to introduce our fiscal 2027 outlook, which anticipates approximately 15% growth in both revenue and Adjusted EBITDA at the midpoint of our guidance ranges.”
The Company’s outlook for fiscal year 2027 with regard to revenue, net income, Adjusted net income, Adjusted EBITDA and Adjusted EBITDA margin is as follows:

Smith commented, “Our fiscal 2027 outlook anticipates substantial growth in both revenue and Adjusted EBITDA, including approximately 6% to 8% organic revenue growth, as we continue to expand our operating platform and execute our long-term growth strategy.

As we move through the second half of fiscal 2027, we expect to benefit from completing lower-margin projects in our acquired backlog and replacing them with higher-margin work, while progressively incorporating increased diesel fuel costs into project pricing through our cost pass-through operating model.
We remain confident in our ability to deliver sustained growth, margin expansion, and long-term shareholder value creation.”
The company also performs private sector projects that include paving and sitework for office and industrial parks, shopping centers, local businesses and residential developments.
